typography.hierarchy_rules: H1 max text-5xl/6xl. Do not exceed these limits. Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for all headings. Overlines should be Uppercase + Wide Spacing. Do not default to Bold, mix Light and SemiBold for contrast.
typography.alignment: Left-align paragraphs, dense content, and cards. Center-align only for specific hero messaging if it improves visual rhythm.

visual enhancers.cards: Rounded premium cards (rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl), 1px subtle borders (border-white/10), flat solid or very dark glassmorphism (bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl).
visual enhancers.glow_effects: Use subtle cyan/blue radial gradients behind hero sections or active elements to create a premium glow effect without overwhelming the dark theme.
visual enhancers.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or slightly rounded (rounded-xl) with clear interaction states. Primary button should use the cyan-to-blue gradient or solid cyan. Secondary button should be outlined or subtle glass.
visual enhancers.glassmorphism: Use Optical Clarity. Heavy blur (backdrop-blur-xl), dark background (bg-black/60), and a 1px delicate inner stroke (border-white/10).

component name.shadcn_ui: Use Shadcn components for structural logic (Forms, Dialogs, Select), heavily customized via Tailwind to match the dark premium branding. Remove standard Vercel-look borders.
component name.hero_phones_mockup: Create realistic, clean HTML/Tailwind CSS mockups of BidBlitz interfaces showing transfer between Max Müller and Anna Schmidt.
component name.live_transfer_card: One large animated transfer card demonstrating speed and success status.
component name.benefits_bento: Bento grid layout for the 5 benefit cards.
component name.investor_portal_dashboard: Use dense, data-rich tables and charts (Recharts) for the investor dashboard area.

grids.bento_grid: Use Mode A 'Tetris' grid for the Benefits section (asymmetry, visual tension). Use Mode B 'High Density' grid for the Investor Dashboard (scanability).
grids.general: Grid items must be direct children. Avoid default Bootstrap columns.

layouts.mobile_first: Start with grid-cols-1. Ensure perfect stacking on 320px, 390px, 430px screens. The hero must communicate the main message in the first 3 seconds without horizontal scrolling.
layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy: Use 2-3x more spacing (py-20, py-24, gap-8). Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-6, p-8).
layouts.sections_order: 1. Hero, 2. Live Demo, 3. How it Works, 4. Benefits, 5. Private/Business, 6. CTA, 7. Bitcoin Mining, 8. Additional services. Investor section goes below wallet hero areas.

motion.transfer_animation: Smooth SVG line drawing or floating particles (framer-motion) connecting sender and recipient phones to visualize the 'In Sekunden' transfer.
motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on cards should have a slight lift (-translate-y-1) and subtle shadow or border glow reveal.
motion.scrolling: Implement smooth, staggered entrance animations for list items and section reveals.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards. Use text-shadow if placed over glows. Never use gray-on-gray.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs, confirmation texts) MUST have a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='start-free-button').
accessibility.focus: Focus states must have HIGHER contrast than default state, not lower.

media.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone or Regular) or lucide-react for professional, clean fintech iconography. Avoid filled/heavy icons unless active. Do NOT use AI assistant emojis.

3d libraries.steps: Use framer-motion for the 2D layout animations (phones communicating, success checkmarks, layout transitions). A full 3D library like R3F is overkill for clean fintech and may distract from the 'fast transfer' messaging. Rely on CSS gradients and framer-motion for the 'subtle glow effects' and 'smooth but restrained animations'.

image urls.description: Professional team collaborating in an office. Use for the Investor landing page (/investieren) header or about section to build trust.
Abstract dark cyan technology background. Use at a very low opacity (10-15%) mixed with a radial gradient mask as the background for the primary Wallet hero section.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the BidBlitz homepage strictly following the section order provided.
Ensure 'Geld senden. Geld empfangen. In Sekunden.' is the primary visible message on load for mobile devices.
Build pure HTML/Tailwind phone mockups for the hero section transferring money from Max Müller to Anna Schmidt. DO NOT use cartoon characters or AI images for this.
Implement the Investor landing page (/investieren) and portal routes (/investor-login, /investor-portal, /admin/...) with a serious, black+cyan aesthetic.
Investor routes should NOT contain payment processing, wallet connections, or gaming language.
Include data-testid on all buttons and actionable items.
Never use pure transparent backgrounds for headers or overlays that content scrolls under. Use dark glassmorphism (bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md).
Keep navigation buttons functional as requested (e.g., 'Jetzt kostenlos starten' goes to registration if logged out).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
Do NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions.
Do NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
Use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with hover animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons.
Add micro-animations for interactions (hover states, entrance animations).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
